sections.label: POB priority in LTA reviews
sections.summary: The POB highlighted by the Member will be given due priority in LTA's future reviews based on the stated criteria.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The POB highlighted by the Member will be accorded due priority in LTA’s future reviews based on the above criteria.

sections.label: POB prioritisation and Phase 4
sections.summary: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary is asked for a time range, and says the POB will get higher priority than POBs with fewer nearby senior residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: So, we would be grateful if the Senior Parliamentary Secretary can give an expected time range for my residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We are now in Phase 4 and we aim to complete Phase 4 by 2028.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: So, currently we are reviewing the POBs among the approximately 600 POBs in Singapore to see how we can prioritise the various POBs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The POB in the Member's constituency as I said will be accorded due priority.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: It would be accorded higher priority than other POBs with a lower number of senior residents living nearby.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We also note that there are clinics and also the Hougang Central Market that would be served by this POB.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: That would be given due priority in our assessment.
